description: Lists the exercise library's collection names with exercise counts, and the equipment categories. Use when the user wants to browse the library by collection or asks which collections or equipment groups exist. Not for muscle groups or single equipment items (use list_muscle_groups or list_equipment). Returns collection names usable as collection_names in list_team_exercises, plus equipment category IDs and names.

availability.description: Which exercises to count: all = team and stock; team = your team's own; free-stock / premium-stock / all-stock = Hyperhuman stock; pay-as-you-go = licensable exercises. Omit for all.
